states.description: An ingested observation that no reviewer has assessed yet.
A reviewer has assessed reproducibility, scope and duplication.
A real control failure with reproducible conditions, root cause and impact.
Not a control failure. Reopened only when new evidence appears.
A remediation addressing the root cause is in progress.
Accepted by a named owner with compensating controls and a future expiry.
A candidate fix is merged and the pipeline passed; awaiting independent retest.
An independent retest against a named artifact shows the original proof no longer succeeds.
A retest failed or a regression reintroduced the weakness.

transitions.rationale: Triage begins once a reviewer confirms the asset is in scope.
Confirmation carries the full evidence set the Finding Hub specification demands.
Dismissal is a recorded decision, not a silent deletion.
New evidence reopens a dismissed observation for assessment.
Work starts against a stated root-cause direction.
Acceptance needs a named owner and an expiry; a safety-boundary failure can never be accepted.
An acceptance that expires or is revoked returns the finding to confirmed.
A candidate fix is only ready once its pipeline passes.
Closure requires an independent retest against the exact tested artifact.
A retest that still reproduces the weakness reopens the finding.
A regression reintroducing the weakness reopens a verified finding.
A reopened finding returns to remediation rather than to triage.
